name: Mobile Timer for Clockify
changes: The Pro notice for the offline queue now has a Sponsor on GitHub button.
tip: Put the cursor on a task line and run 'Start timer for this task' to time it.
thanks: Hi, I am Michael, a solo developer in Poland. Mobile Timer for Clockify is one of over 100 small plugins that I make. Thank you for using it to track your time.
